IdleTimeout.description: Set idle timeout (in seconds) before the connection will be disconnect and the input device is removed. 0 means disabled.

UserspaceHID.description: Enable HID protocol handling in userspace input profile. Possible values: 'persist' (UHID persistent mode, keyboard only), 'true' (UHID), or 'false' (kernel HIDP). The value must be quoted in the config file if it is a string to ensure correct parsing.

ClassicBondedOnly.description: Limit HID connections to bonded devices. For security, defaults to true. The value must be quoted in the config file if it is a string to ensure correct parsing.

LEAutoSecurity.description: Enable automatic LE security upgrades if required. Defaults to true for compatibility. The value must be quoted in the config file if it is a string to ensure correct parsing.
